newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Dina rated speculative buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Dina rated speculative buy.

text.p: - Interacciones brokerage said it initiated coverage of Mexican truck and bus maker Consorcio Grupo Dina with a rating of speculative buy.
- Analyst Robert Hulme said the markets of the company were cyclical and "should recover in line with the economic recovery."
- Public contracts in the company's bus division should give an additional push to sales volumes, he said.
- "The company has restructured its Eurobond debt and we believe that the risk of non-fulfillment of debt is minimal," he said.
- Shares continue to trade at a liquidity value but should improve rapidly as the market risk perception alters, he said.
